title: Dice
body:
Dice are an item found in Fungi Finds. They can be purchased for a price of $2,150.

The dice come in different forms, such as a d4, d6, d8, d10, d12, and d20. They can also have different colors and materials.

The description reads: "Wow, it's like they WANTED us to play Dungeons & Dragons!"

Despite being named Dice, only one is included. The singular term is "Die," while the plural is "Dice."

The d10 is only ambiguous and unfair dice since release, up to this date. Because this dice is shaped as pentagonal bipyramid, and it's incorrectly labeled on sides, not edges. It would be fair dice if the labels are on edges.
